files.name: ExploreSideways.java

help: explore_sideways: after explore for animals timed out, walk sideways/toward a far animal until one is in view
lesson: An explore that times out on a 120-block path toward one spot gets better odds from a short sideways walk by keys that stops when an animal comes into view than from a long path in the same direction.
summary: explore_sideways: after explore:cow TIMEOUT in the overworld, walk to a farm animal that's in sight but farther than 32 blocks, or walk by keys up to 56 blocks at 90° to the old heading.
